why: Two independent tests are copy-pasted verbatim (same logic, same comments, trivially different literals) into separate files: InvalidTrackOperationException.toString is tested identically in track_dao_deactivate_test.dart and track_dao_delete_test.dart, and the activate-then-deactivate W3.22 smoke test is tested identically in track_dao_delete_test.dart and track_dao_test.dart. Each pair evidently came from independent 'add missing coverage' passes that didn't check what already existed. No functional risk today, but the exception-message format or the W3.22 behavior now needs updating in two places to stay in sync, and it inflates the very AG-3 line counts flagged separately.
recommendation: Keep one canonical copy of each test (e.g. in track_dao_test.dart for the W3.22 case, track_dao_deactivate_test.dart for the exception case) and delete the other copy.
acceptance_criteria: InvalidTrackOperationException.toString is tested in exactly one file in this directory.
